subject: Mutual evaluation roadmap + Azure private offer and commitment tiers
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Andrew Mason <andrew.mason@retailco.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual evaluation roadmap + next steps for Azure private offer

Hi Andrew —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our conversation, I put together a short mutual evaluation roadmap so RetailCo and Redwood can align on success criteria, timelines, and the commercial milestones tied to a private offer on Azure. The key points:

- 2-week pilot (PoC) focused on search ranking improvements and latency targets
- Commit milestone after pilot to reserve dedicated capacity (3-month initial commit)
- Ramp milestones at months 3/6 for committed throughput and unit-price discounts
- Final close / private offer acceptance contingent on signed PO and DocuSign within agreed close window

Attached: RetailCo_MAP_v1.xlsx — it has a proposed acceptance checklist, technical eval plan, and the tiered pricing ladder that links discounts to commit size and ramp follow-through.

Quick ask: can we lock a pilot start on Aug 3rd? That gives your engineering team time to provision a sandbox subscription and for us to prepare an Azure private offer draft keyed to the MAP milestones.

If that works I’ll loop in finance and legal on our side to get a draft private offer ready (we generally include a staged discount profile that increases with committed spend and verified ramp metrics).

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com | +1 415-555-1234
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: RetailCo_MAP_v1.xlsx (xlsx)]
From: Andrew Mason <andrew.mason@retailco.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Jin <sara.jin@retailco.com>, procurement@retailco.com
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual evaluation roadmap + next steps for Azure private offer

Ava —

Thanks for this and the clear MAP. A couple notes from our side:

- We like the staged discount idea but need visibility into the absolute committed spend thresholds (monthly and total) — can you put numbers next to the tiers?
- Our procurement team needs the private offer to be an Azure Private Offer (not just an invoice credit). Can your finance/legal team prepare that version?
- Pilot start Aug 3rd is OK; Sara and I will confirm sandbox access by Aug 1.

Can you also include an example DocuSign flow and a target close date so we can align internal approvers?

Best,
Andrew Mason
Head of Platform Engineering | RetailCo
andrew.mason@retailco.com
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: RetailCo MAP — numbers needed for Azure private offer

Folks — forwarding Andrew's note. Action items:

1) Ben/Marissa: please open the draft Azure private offer and populate the commit tiers. Target structure we discussed with similar deals:
   - Tier A: $25k/month commit -> 12% discount off hosted list, 3-month minimum
   - Tier B: $50k/month commit -> 18% discount, 6-month minimum + guaranteed throughput SLA
   - Tier C: $100k/month commit -> 25% discount, 12-month minimum + dedicated pool
   (These are placeholders — need finance confirmation.)

2) Dylan: can you prepare an Azure private-offer PDF that maps these tiers to the MAP milestones and includes a sample DocuSign signing flow and estimated close date (we should aim for Aug 20th as the DocuSign completion target so RetailCo can onboard in September).

3) I’ll confirm pilot kickoff Aug 3rd once Sara confirms sandbox.

Please keep the numbers conservative for initial x-firm approval — finance may nudge on minimum commit requirements.

Thanks,
Ava

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2026 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RetailCo MAP — draft private offer and approval request

Hi all —

Attached is the draft Azure_Private_Offer_Draft.pdf and a PO template (PO_template_RetailCo.docx) that we would send to RetailCo via DocuSign. Key commercial points in the draft:

- Baseline (no commit): standard hosted retail pricing
- Tier A: $25k/mo commit -> 12% list discount; 3-month min; ramp check at month 3 to qualify for next tier
- Tier B: $50k/mo commit -> 18% list discount; 6-month min; requires 60% of committed throughput in month 3 and 80% in month 6 to keep discount
- Tier C: $100k/mo commit -> 25% list discount; 12-month min; dedicated pool + 99.9% uptime SLA

I recommend we keep the early-stage concession at Tier A conservative but give flexibility to apply a one-time onboarding credit ($10k) to cover integration costs if RetailCo signs within two weeks of the pilot start.

Evelyn — request approval for:
  a) The tiered discount structure above
  b) Onboarding credit up to $10k if we want to accelerate the close to Aug 20th

If approved I’ll prepare the Azure Private Offer in the marketplace portal and send the DocuSign link to RetailCo.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Head of Finance Ops | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Azure_Private_Offer_Draft.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: PO_template_RetailCo.docx (docx)]
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RetailCo MAP — draft private offer and approval request

Thanks team — reviewed the draft. Approve the tiered structure and a one-time onboarding credit up to $10,000 to help drive a faster close. Conditions:

- Onboarding credit is applied only if DocuSign is completed by Aug 20, 2026 and RetailCo meets pilot acceptance criteria by Aug 31, 2026.
- Tier escalation requires verification of ramp metrics (Dylan to document verification checklist in the offer).
- Finance to include clawback language if ramp metrics are not met within the first 3 months.

Dylan — please proceed to publish the Azure Private Offer in the marketplace portal and generate the DocuSign envelope. Ava — once DocuSign is live, send the link to Andrew and Sara with the MAP and PO template.

Evelyn Hart
VP, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
[evelyn.hart@redwood.com]
